title: Service Terms Schedule, VPS and Dedicated Servers: Money-Back Period, Notice and Auto-Renew
content:
The terms of service for the VPS and Dedicated Servers range fix, for each tier, the money-back period, the notice a scheduled cancellation needs, whether a server may be cancelled with immediate effect, and how auto-renew is set and timed.

## Money-back guarantee and cancellation

| Tier | Money-back period: calendar days after the opening date within which a cancellation is refunded | Shortest term covered by the money-back guarantee (months) | Notice period: calendar days of notice a scheduled cancellation needs before it takes effect | Cancellation with immediate effect allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | 30 | 1 | 0 | Yes |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | 30 | 1 | 0 | Yes |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | 30 | 1 | 0 | Yes |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | 30 | 1 | 0 | Yes |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | 0 | 1 | 30 | No |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | 0 | 1 | 30 | No |

A money-back period of 0 means the tier has no money-back guarantee. A notice period of 0 means a scheduled cancellation takes effect at term end.

## Auto-renew

| Tier | Auto-renew on by default | Auto-renew charging lead: days before the term end on which the renewal is charged |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | Yes | 5 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | Yes | 5 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | Yes | 5 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | Yes | 5 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | Yes | 5 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | Yes | 5 |

## Reading the schedule

- The two Harborline Dedicated tiers have no money-back guarantee and need 30 calendar days of notice; the four Harborline VPS tiers have a 30-day money-back period and no notice period.
- Every tier is ordered with auto-renew on, and on every tier the renewal is charged 5 days before the term end.
